subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Dead lock

options.text: A state in which progress is impossible

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct alternative** that best expresses the meaning of the idiom** "Deadlock"** is **"A state in which progress is impossible".**
 
• A **"Deadlock" i**s a situation in which two opposing forces find that they cannot move or make any progress because neither will yield or compromise, rendering the situation unresolvable unless one of the parties changes their stance.( गतिरोध)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:* 'A state in which progress is impossible'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's look at the meanings of the other phrases:
 
 
• **To be anxious: **It means to be very worried, nervous, or uneasy about something with an uncertain outcome.( चिंतित होना)
 
• **To lose an important asset:** It means to lose something or someone that is very valuable or useful.(महत्वपूर्ण संपत्ति खोना)
 
• **To attract:** It means to draw or pull someone or something towards them, by the qualities they have, especially good ones.(आकर्षित करना)

The correct answer is 'Option 3'.</strong&g
